# **Architectural Blueprint and Agentic Implementation Plan for a Next-Generation 3D Tactical Military Simulation**

## **Deconstruction of the Baseline Title and Market Opportunity**

The mobile simulation title *Military Academy 3D* (com.slg.MilitaryAcademy3D), developed by SLG XTREME and published across Android and iOS ecosystems by CrazyLabs LTD and Coco Play By TabTale, demonstrates substantial market demand for career-spanning military progression games1. Accumulating over 5,000,000 downloads on Android and 37,000 ratings with a 4.7-star average on the iOS App Store, the baseline application validates the commercial appeal of guiding an enlistee from basic training to the pinnacle of military and political command1. Despite strong top-of-funnel acquisition, critical evaluations assign the title a mediocre 7 out of 10 rating, pointing to shallow arcade mechanics, uninspired audiovisual presentation, and severe state-management defects that fracture long-term player retention3.  
![][image1]  
An examination of the version trajectory from v0.1.2 in August 2023 through v0.4.1 in November 2025 and subsequent 2026 builds reveals why the legacy application struggles with structural cohesion2. The original architecture began as a collection of disconnected first-person and third-person casual mini-games—such as basic pistol and rifle target practice and three-option dialogue prompts—before rapidly bolting on tournament modes (v0.1.3), character customization and skill trees (v0.1.5), expanded weapon variety (v0.1.8), a revamped idle base meta-game (v0.2.0), naval ship production and DIY weapon levels (v0.2.4), vehicle customization (v0.2.8), and a battle pass (v0.3.1)2. Because these systems were layered onto a casual framework without a unified state bus or physically grounded combat loop, the binary footprint swelled from 313.1 MB to 382.8 MB on Android and 514.2 MB on iOS while introducing severe progression deadlocks2.

| Legacy Subsystem | Baseline Implementation (com.slg.MilitaryAcademy3D) | Documented Engineering & Design Failure Modes | Next-Generation 3D Realistic Target Architecture |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Rank & Career State Machine** | Linear chapter progression from Recruit/Private (PVT) to Lieutenant, General, and President1. | Chapter 8 state regression resets Lieutenant rank label to PVT; General promotion screen fails to render the "Continue" event trigger, causing a permanent soft-lock5. | Deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM) backed by immutable event-sourced promotion ledgers and automated UI state verification8. |
| **Visual Identity & Customization** | Three preset avatars with basic skin/character unlocks added in v0.1.5 and v0.1.72. | Character uniforms fail to update dynamically upon rank promotion, breaking immersion across career tiers5. | Modular skeletal mesh garment system bound to the Rank FSM, automatically swapping insignia, dress uniforms, and tactical loadouts per grade. |
| **Weapon Crafting ("DIY") & Gunsmithing** | Casual "DIY levels" introduced in v0.2.4 and basic store weapon variety in v0.1.82. | Superficial puzzle-like assembly with no mechanical link between internal components and ballistic performance2. | Physically modeled 3D Gunsmith workbench with interchangeable barrels, calibers, FFP/SFP optics, adjustable triggers, and recoil buffers9. |
| **Combat & Ballistics Engine** | Alternating first-person and third-person arcade shooting mini-games with sensitivity sliders (v0.2.5)2. | Disjointed arcade hit detection lacking sight alignment, ballistic drop, stance stability, or realistic wound mechanics3. | Strict raycast-from-muzzle and sight-vector validation, anatomical hitbox multipliers, armor penetration, and acoustic reverb11. |
| **Narrative & Endgame Meta** | Binary voice conversations, idle base/ship production (v0.2.0, v0.2.4), and Presidential finale2. | Dialogue choices are trivially obvious; Presidential endgame lacks governance mechanics and culminates in an abrupt, unrewarding ending3. | Consequence-driven tactical dilemma engine integrated with a Strategic Command & National Development simulator at General/Presidential ranks5. |
| **Monetization & Session Flow** | Free-to-play with in-app purchases and Battle Pass (v0.3.1)2. | Ad triggers execute mid-mission during high-tension combat sequences rather than at mission boundaries5. | Non-intrusive telemetry and checkpoint boundary hooks that strictly prohibit state interruption during active combat scenes. |

The causal relationship between these defects is fundamentally architectural: when rank progression, uniform rendering, weapon statistics, and mission triggers are hardcoded inside individual scene scripts rather than governed by a decoupled domain layer, updating the level order (as occurred in v0.1.7) corrupts serialized player state2. Transforming this concept into a realistic 3D tactical military simulation via AI-assisted development ("vibecoding") requires replacing scene-coupled scripts with a modular Clean Architecture while enforcing strict non-destructive coding rules so AI agents never overwrite validated logic8.

## **Core System Design: Narrative, Rank Hierarchy, and Strategic Meta-Game**

To resolve the narrative flatness and progression soft-locks of the baseline game, the career simulation must operate as a five-act hierarchical state machine where every promotion unlocks higher-order tactical, mechanical, and geopolitical systems1. Rather than treating dialogue as a cosmetic binary quiz where the appropriate response is trivially obvious, conversations must function as high-stakes leadership evaluations modeled on military command boards, televised policy debates, and public rallies3. Verbal responses modify three persistent officer attributes—Tactical Doctrine, Unit Morale, and Political Capital—which directly govern squad AI responsiveness in combat and budget allocations in the base meta-game.

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| **Tier 2: Sergeant to Staff NCO (E5\_SGT – E8\_MSG)** | Act II (Chapters 4–6) | Tactical plate carrier, NCO chevrons, squad comms rig, night-vision mount. | Fireteam CQB breach-and-clear missions, night operations, and Harries flashlight stance combat11. | Custom trigger group tuning (900g–1500g), sound suppressors, Picatinny rails, and Second Focal Plane (SFP) optics9. |
| **Tier 3: Lieutenant to Captain (O1\_LT – O3\_CPT)** | Act III (Chapters 7–9) | Officer service dress in garrison; custom modular chest rig with gold/silver bars in field. | Combined-arms platoon command, vehicle customization integration, and dynamic sniper/counter-sniper operations2. | Full caliber conversion barrels, First Focal Plane (FFP) MRAD scopes, zero-stop turrets, and Kick-Off recoil buffers9. |
| **Tier 4: Major to Four-Star General (O4\_MAJ – O10\_GEN)** | Act IV (Chapters 10–12) | Decorated General Officer dress uniform with ribbon rack; Command Ops tactical suit. | Theater-level battle map strategy, naval ship production management, and high-value special operations1. | Experimental titanium receivers, custom ammunition metallurgy, and automated base manufacturing lines2. |
| **Tier 5: Commander-in-Chief / President (CIV\_PRES)** | Act V (Endgame) | Tailored civilian executive suit with Commander-in-Chief lapel pin and Secret Service detail. | National development, legislative policy enactment, defense budget allocation, crisis diplomacy, and strategic deterrence3. | National Arsenal R\&D directives, fleet-wide vehicle/ship standardization, and global tournament war games2. |

Addressing the specific Chapter 8 regression—where players promoted to Lieutenant reverted to PVT and froze at the General promotion dialogue—requires decoupling the UI presentation layer from the underlying RankProgressionService5. In a deterministic Finite State Machine (FSM), rank transitions must follow a strict monotonic guard: a transition from state ![][image2] to ![][image3] is valid if and only if current experience ![][image4], required qualification modules are marked COMPLETED in the persistent ledger, and the state index satisfies ![][image5]. Furthermore, the promotion ceremony cutscene must subscribe to an asynchronous OnPromotionAcknowledged event bus signal backed by a fallback watchdog timer; if the dialogue animation fails to fire its completion frame within 3.0 seconds, the UI controller automatically forces the Continue button into an active, interactable state, permanently eliminating soft-locks5. Every promotion event simultaneously triggers the skeletal garment binder to swap the character's uniform mesh and rank insignia, resolving player complaints regarding static uniforms across promotions5.  
At the culmination of the military hierarchy, the transition to President (CIV\_PRES) directly addresses player critiques that the baseline game lacks national development mechanics and ends abruptly5. Instead of recycling basic shooting levels, Act V utilizes the meta-camera zoom-out architecture introduced in v0.2.6 to transition seamlessly into a strategic command hub2. Within this executive theater, the commander-in-chief balances industrial ship and vehicle production (v0.2.4, v0.2.8) with civil infrastructure, enacting constitutional roles, managing defense treaties, and answering unscripted press and rally questions that test policy expertise before authorizing surgical special-operations strikes2.

## **3D Realistic Gunsmithing ("Make and Use") and Ballistic Engineering**

Elevating the casual "DIY levels" (v0.2.4) and store unlocks (v0.1.8) into a realistic 3D weapon-making and tactical shooting system requires modeling firearm engineering as an interconnected mechanical graph that feeds directly into the ballistic raycast pipeline2. In a physically grounded Gunsmith system, every weapon is assembled around a serialized Core Receiver (such as a Titanium Receiver Chassis) containing typed attachment sockets for a Cold-Hammered Barrel, an M14 Sound Suppressor, a First Focal Plane Optic, a Linear Bolt System, an Adjustable Trigger Group, and a Hydraulic Recoil Pad9. Rather than applying arbitrary arcade damage boosts, each manufactured or swapped component alters specific physical parameters—mass, overall length (OAL), center of balance, muzzle velocity, mechanical dispersion (measured in Minute of Angle, MOA), cyclic rate of fire, and recoil impulse—which subsequently govern the convergence of the Optic Sight Vector and Muzzle Raycast Vector against downrange anatomical hitboxes (specifically the Cranial Hitbox, Sternum Hitbox, and Pelvic Hitbox)9.

### **Mechanical Gunsmith Architecture ("Gun Make")**

In the 3D Gunsmith Workbench, firearm fabrication and assembly operate across seven interdependent mechanical subsystems derived from precision firearm engineering standards9. The foundational chassis—modeled on an Accuracy International AICS AX chassis or a tri-alloy receiver—establishes structural rigidity and bedding geometry9. Precision bedding geometry ensures that when barrels are swapped in the field, the barrel seats in the exact micro-alignment required to guarantee ![][image6] mechanical accuracy without losing optic zero9. Barrels are machined using cold-hammer forging and vacuum distension processes across standard (![][image7] barrel / ![][image8] OAL) and magnum (![][image9] barrel / ![][image10] OAL) dimensions with a ![][image11] profile and ![][image12] rifling twist9. Because the optic mount interfaces directly with the barrel assembly or monolithic upper, operators can swap calibers—converting a platform between ![][image13] NATO, ![][image14], and ![][image15]—simply by exchanging the barrel, bolt head, and magazine well9.  
To optimize cyclic reliability, standard rotating bolts can be upgraded to a linear reloading mechanism featuring a ![][image16] ergonomic bolt handle positioned directly above the trigger9. Operating via a straight back-and-forward sliding motion rather than multi-turn rotation, this linear bolt system prevents binding during rapid firing cycles and permits tool-free ![][image17] bolt-head reversal to switch cartridge ejection between right-hand and left-hand configurations independent of handle placement9. Beneath the receiver, the fire-control group incorporates an adjustable trigger pull weight configurable in three stages from ![][image18] to ![][image19], directly modifying trigger-response latency and aim-sway perturbation upon release9. A realistic three-position manual safety governs weapon readiness states: the first position permits both firing and reloading; the second position mechanically blocks the trigger while leaving the bolt unlocked for safe chamber loading or unloading; and the third position locks both the trigger and the bolt carrier9.  
At the forward end of the barrel, an ![][image20] threaded muzzle with a thread cover accepts tactical muzzle brakes (such as a Badger Ordnance FTE brake) or sound suppressors9. Suppressors reduce the acoustic detection radius and eliminate visible muzzle flash—while strictly capping muzzle smoke particle opacity to prevent the thick smoke occlusion defects observed in legacy tactical shooters—and accurately model "first-shot pop," an increased acoustic signature on the initial round caused by oxygen combustion inside the suppressor baffles11. Sighting systems mount via Picatinny rails, quick-detachable interfaces, or signature tactical rings, dividing optics into Second Focal Plane (SFP) and First Focal Plane (FFP) architectures9. SFP reticles maintain a constant visual line thickness favored for fixed-distance target shooting, where Minute of Angle (MOA) subtension math is exact at maximum magnification (such as ![][image21]) and doubles when zoomed down to half power (![][image22])10. Conversely, FFP reticles scale dynamically across the magnification range (![][image23] to ![][image21]), ensuring Milliradian (MRAD) holdover values remain mathematically true at every zoom setting during dynamic combat10. High-tier optics also incorporate a left-side parallax adjustment turret (![][image24] to infinity) and set-screw zero-stop turrets for instant return to calibrated zero10. Finally, the stock assembly integrates length-of-pull spacers (![][image25] base with ![][image26] spacers), a soft MicroCore recoil pad that slides smoothly into the shoulder pocket without snagging clothing, and internal hydraulic dampeners (Kick-Off, Kick-Off Plus, and Kick-Off Mega) that absorb up to ![][image27] of recoil impulse9.

### **Deterministic Ballistics and Aim-Validation Logic ("Gun Use")**

A primary mandate for the engineering implementation is enforcing strict logical causality in combat: a weapon may only inflict damage when its physical aiming vector and ballistic trajectory genuinely intersect a target's anatomical collider, with zero tolerance for proximity auto-hits, camera-FOV sight misalignment, or animation-clipping exploits11. Casual shooters frequently cast rays purely from the center of the viewport, enabling players to hit targets while the physical gun barrel is obstructed by cover or suffering from Field of View (FOV) scaling distortion11. To eliminate these flaws, the realistic combat engine decouples weapon sight alignment from camera FOV so the optical reticle remains locked to the true sightline while the projectile originates strictly from the 3D MuzzleTransform.position along MuzzleTransform.forward11. For any shot to register damage, the angular alignment between the optic sight vector ![][image78] and the target vector ![][image79] must fall within the aiming cone while the physical path between the muzzle origin ![][image80] and impact point ![][image81] remains completely unobstructed by environmental geometry:  
![][image82]  
If the operator is not actively aiming at the enemy collider or if a wall, desk, or shield obstructs the physical barrel line-of-sight, calculated damage is strictly zero11. Once the firing pin strikes a chambered cartridge—requiring the manual safety to be in Position 1, the bolt locked closed, and the trigger pull threshold completed—the projectile trajectory is integrated across discrete physics time steps ![][image83] with initial velocity ![][image84] perturbed by the barrel's mechanical MOA dispersion and current stance sway:  
![][image85]  
In this ballistic formulation, ![][image86] represents projectile mass, ![][image87] represents the aerodynamic drag coefficient, ![][image88] denotes cross-sectional area, and ![][image89] denotes ambient air density. Consistent with empirical tactical shooting principles, a few millimeters of projectile diameter (![][image90] versus ![][image32]) matter far less than exact anatomical placement and armor penetration12. Consequently, every combatant skeletal mesh replaces single-capsule hit detection with four specialized anatomical hitboxes, accompanied by dynamic entry and exit wound decals12.

| Anatomical Hitbox Zone | Collider Identifier | Kinetic Damage Multiplier | Armor Interaction & Tactical Ballistic Effect |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| **Cranial Vault** | Hitbox\_Skull | ![][image91] (Critical) | Bypasses thoracic plate carriers; serves as the finishing target in the Mozambique Drill after two sternum impacts12. |
| **Sternum & Thoracic Vitals** | Hitbox\_Torso | ![][image92] (Baseline) | Checks projectile penetration against plate carrier rating; absorbs initial double-tap momentum in center-of-mass drills12. |
| **Pelvic Girdle** | Hitbox\_Pelvis | ![][image93] (Mobility) | Bypasses heavy torso armor to shatter structural support, immediately forcing heavily armored opponents into a collapsed state12. |
| **Upper & Lower Extremities** | Hitbox\_Limbs | ![][image94] (Peripheral) | Generates entry/exit wound decals; arm hits degrade weapon aim stability while leg hits penalize movement velocity12. |

Operator posture and grip geometry further govern weapon stability and silhouette exposure. The Isosceles stance squares the operator toward the threat to maximize frontal armor protection at the cost of a wider profile; the Weaver stance angles the torso using isometric push-pull tension to tighten the silhouette; and the Harries stance crosses the firearm wrist over an off-hand tactical flashlight to illuminate dark interiors while bracing recoil12. Every discharged round applies an immediate spring-based physical recoil impulse scaled by the gunsmith KickOffReduction parameter (![][image95]), explicitly preventing rapid-click zero-recoil shotgun or rifle exploits9. Furthermore, UI weapon cards dynamically query the true physics firing interval (![][image96]) so menu statistics never desynchronize from actual cyclic rates, avoiding bugs such as listing ![][image97] in menus when a rifle fires at ![][image98]11.  
Ammunition management tracks magazines as discrete physical objects in the operator's chest rig rather than an abstract global pool12. Executing a tactical reload during a lull in combat swaps a partially depleted magazine for a fresh one while retaining the chambered round (![][image99]) and stowing the partial magazine for later use, whereas reloading from an empty chamber requires actuating the bolt release or ![][image16] linear handle9. To eliminate physical clipping exploits where prone or leaning operators push barrels or head hitboxes through walls, desks, or ballistic shields, the character controller executes a continuous forward capsule-cast bounding-box check11. Whenever an obstacle enters the weapon's overall length envelope, procedural inverse kinematics smoothly retract the firearm into a compressed ready posture and inhibit firing until muzzle clearance is restored, while state-machine guards block simultaneous prone-transition and melee animations11. Finally, each gunshot queries an indoor/outdoor spatial enclosure check and distance vector, synthesizing realistic indoor acoustic reflection reverb alongside 27 distinct supersonic bullet crack sounds whenever rounds pass within a two-meter suppression envelope13.

## **Agentic "Vibecoding" Methodology and Non-Destructive Engineering Architecture**

Building a complex, multi-system 3D simulation using AI coding agents (such as Cursor, Windsurf, or Claude Code) introduces a well-documented operational hazard: left unconstrained, AI agents act as eager "yes-men" that hallucinate non-existent engine APIs, suffer from context drift over extended sessions, and destructively rewrite or delete working code while attempting to resolve narrow issues16. Empirical engineering analyses of agentic workflows demonstrate that treating rules files as motivational posters fails; instead, high-reliability vibecoding requires strict context-window budgeting, modular domain decoupling, and deterministic execution gates16.  
![][image100]

### **Context Window Economy and Multi-File Rule Partitioning**

Because context window saturation is the primary cause of AI agents overlooking instructions and overwriting existing logic mid-conversation, placing a massive 2,000-line game design tutorial into a single always-on prompt degrades model compliance16. Production benchmarks establish that an optimal vibecoding configuration partitions project governance into two concise Always-On files (strictly under 200 lines each) that load on every conversation, paired with four Domain-Specific Auto-Attached files (150 to 300 lines each) that activate dynamically via file globs only when the agent edits files within that specific architectural zone22.

| Rule File Path | Activation Mode & Glob Pattern | Line Budget | Architectural Responsibility & Non-Destructive Guardrails |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| .cursor/rules/00-project-index.mdc | alwaysApply: true (\*) | ![][image101] lines | Defines project identity, engine/stack, folder map, the Registry of Built Modules (MODULE\_LOCK.json), and references all domain rule files16. |
| .cursor/rules/01-non-destructive-standards.mdc | alwaysApply: true (\*) | ![][image102] lines | Enforces the "Martial Arts" combat-style execution sequence (SEARCH FIRST, REUSE FIRST, MINIMAL DIFF), file size cap (![][image103] lines), and zero-overwrite policy17. |
| .cursor/rules/10-combat-ballistics.mdc | Auto-Attached (\*\*/Combat/\*\*, \*\*/Weapons/Usage/\*\*) | ![][image104] lines | Enforces dual-vector raycast aim validation, FOV-decoupled optics, anatomical hitbox math, stance physics, and anti-clipping capsule checks11. |
| .cursor/rules/20-gunsmith-crafting.mdc | Auto-Attached (\*\*/Gunsmith/\*\*, \*\*/Weapons/Parts/\*\*) | ![][image104] lines | Enforces immutable WeaponPartSO data contracts, socket compatibility trees, 3 SUB MOA bedding rules, FFP/SFP reticle math, and Kick-Off recoil formulas9. |
| .cursor/rules/30-rank-narrative-fsm.mdc | Auto-Attached (\*\*/Progression/\*\*, \*\*/Narrative/\*\*) | ![][image104] lines | Prevents the Chapter 8 PVT regression and General soft-lock via monotonic FSM guards, dynamic uniform mesh binding, and 3-second UI watchdog timers5. |
| .cursor/rules/40-meta-persistence.mdc | Auto-Attached (\*\*/Meta/\*\*, \*\*/SaveSystem/\*\*, \*\*/UI/\*\*) | ![][image104] lines | Governs base/ship production idle math, Presidential national development simulation, schema migrations, and mission-boundary ad/checkpoint hooks2. |

### **Six-Stage Non-Destructive Vibecoding Protocol**

To guarantee that once a feature is built and verified, subsequent prompts never replace or break it, the engineering workflow enforces six sequential operational gates derived from high-performing agentic software teams17. Every task begins in Plan Mode (Shift+Tab), where instead of immediately generating code, the agent researches the repository via grep and semantic search, identifies relevant files, formulates an implementation blueprint with exact file references, and waits for architectural approval17. If an agent diverges from requirements during code generation, reverting the working tree and refining the initial plan produces cleaner, non-destructive code far faster than stacking corrective follow-up prompts23. During this discovery phase, the agent adheres strictly to a "Search First, Reuse First" mandate, checking existing functions, patterns, and directory structures before creating new classes16. Under Clean Architecture and the Open-Closed Principle, validated modules are locked against destructive modification and extended solely via interfaces, dependency injection, or Event Bus subscriptions8.  
When introducing new gameplay capabilities, the workflow requires a domain-first implementation paired with result-typed error handling21. Rather than embedding ballistic calculations or rank promotions directly inside UI button handlers or scene scripts, the agent constructs pure domain functions that return an explicit Result\<T, GameError\> type instead of throwing unhandled exceptions or silently stalling5. This domain logic is locked in place through Test-Driven Development (TDD): the agent first writes unit tests based on expected input and output pairs—such as asserting that firing a weapon when IsAimedAtTarget \== false yields 0 damage, or that promoting from O1\_LT cannot revert to E1\_PVT—and confirms the tests fail before writing implementation code5. Once the test suite is committed, the agent iterates on the implementation while strictly forbidden from altering the tests23.  
Throughout code generation, strict file-size and dead-code hygiene rules keep every source file under 300 lines17. Because language models mimic the surrounding repository, leaving dead functions, unused imports, or monolithic scripts causes agents to replicate anti-patterns and overwrite adjacent methods17. Finally, to prevent context drift across long conversations, the agent must prepend every response with an explicit rule compliance header (for example, "Applying rules: \[SEARCH\_FIRST, NON\_DESTRUCTIVE\_EXTENSION, STRICT\_AIM\_VALIDATION\]"), refresh its reading of the rules file every few turns, and inspect runtime and compiler logs before declaring any task complete16.

## **Phased Implementation Roadmap**

Executing this architecture through vibecoding requires a strict six-phase build order where foundational data contracts and state machines are locked in the module registry prior to constructing 3D combat or strategic meta-game loops8. Phase 1 establishes the decoupled Clean Architecture foundation, including the central EventBus, the Result\<T, E\> error-handling primitive, the MODULE\_REGISTRY.json lock file, and the immutable save ledger so that no subsequent feature relies on fragile scene-to-scene singletons8. Phase 2 builds the monotonic RankFSM and UniformMeshBinder, immediately solving the legacy Chapter 8 rank reset and General promotion freeze while linking rank state changes to dynamic 3D uniform swaps5.  
With career state persistence verified and locked, Phase 3 constructs the 3D Gunsmith workbench (WeaponChassis, PartSocketGraph, and BallisticStatAggregator), allowing players to assemble receivers, swap calibers while retaining ![][image6] bedding accuracy, tune trigger weights, and mount FFP or SFP optics9. Phase 4 wires these serialized weapon assemblies into the 3D tactical combat engine (DualVectorBallistics, AnatomicalHitbox, StanceController, and BoundingBoxGuard), enforcing the strict rule that damage occurs only upon verified sight-vector and muzzle-raycast intersection with anatomical colliders11. Phase 5 layers the first-person and third-person academy training courses, tournament brackets (v0.1.3, v0.1.5), and the three-way leadership dilemma engine2. Finally, Phase 6 integrates the zoom-out meta-camera (v0.2.6), naval ship and vehicle production queues (v0.2.4, v0.2.8), and the Presidential national governance simulator (CIV\_PRES), while locking monetization and save hooks strictly to post-mission boundaries2.

The unified specification block below is engineered to be saved directly in the project root as GAME\_MASTER\_SPEC.md (with its core directives mirrored in .cursor/rules/00-core-architecture.mdc)16. Written in a high-density, low-token directive format designed for Always-Apply agentic compliance, this single document provides AI coding agents with the complete game design specification, mathematical combat formulas, rank progression tables, gunsmith architectures, and non-destructive coding guardrails16.

## **description: Master Game Design, Technical Architecture, and Non-Destructive Vibecoding Rules for Project: Vanguard Academy 3D (Realistic Evolution of Military Academy 3D) globs: \["/\*"\] alwaysApply: true**

# **PROJECT: VANGUARD ACADEMY 3D — MASTER SPECIFICATION & AGENT RULES**

## **1\. CRITICAL PARTNER MINDSET & NON-DESTRUCTIVE EXECUTION PROTOCOL**

Always start every response with: Applying Rules: \[SEARCH\_FIRST \| NON\_DESTRUCTIVE \| STRICT\_LOGIC \| \<ACTIVE\_MODULE\>\]

### **1.1 THE GOLDEN RULE OF NON-DESTRUCTIVE VIBECODING**

* **NEVER REPLACE OR DELETE WORKING CODE**: If a module, class, state machine, UI component, or weapon script is already built and functioning, the AI agent MUST NOT overwrite, delete, or rewrite it from scratch.  
* **SEARCH FIRST**: Before writing any code, run grep and semantic codebase searches to locate existing implementations, data structures, and interfaces.  
* **EXTEND, DO NOT MUTATE (Open-Closed Principle)**: Add new functionality by extending interfaces, creating new ScriptableObjects/Data Assets, or subscribing to the EventBus. Strive for the smallest possible diff.  
* **PROTECT THE MODULE REGISTRY**: Check MODULE\_REGISTRY.json before editing. Any module marked "status": "LOCKED\_VERIFIED" cannot have its public API signature or core logic altered without explicit human override.  
* **FILE SIZE & HYGIENE CAP**: Keep all source files under 300 lines. Split Domain Logic, State Data, and 3D View/Animation Controllers into separate files. Never leave dead functions or unused imports.  
* **NO ASSUMPTIONS OR HALLUCINATED APIS**: Rely strictly on files read and verified engine documentation. If a dependency or asset path is ambiguous, pause and ask for clarification in Plan Mode.

### **1.2 MANDATORY 6-STEP EXECUTION SEQUENCE**

> 1. **SCAN**: Read target files, nearby modules, and MODULE\_REGISTRY.json.  
> 2. **PLAN**: Output exact file paths to be created or extended and explain how existing built logic is preserved.  
> 3. **TEST CONTRACT (TDD)**: Define input/output unit tests for the new logic first. Never modify existing passing tests to force a broken implementation to pass.  
> 4. **DOMAIN IMPLEMENTATION**: Write pure domain logic returning Result\<T, GameError\>. Never place business or ballistic logic inside UI buttons or animation callbacks.  
> 5. **VIEW WIRING**: Connect 3D meshes, cameras, IK, and HUD elements via EventBus signals.  
> 6. **VERIFY**: Run type checks, linter checks, and unit tests. Inspect runtime logs for errors before reporting completion.

## **2\. ARCHITECTURE & DIRECTORY TOPOLOGY**

Maintain strict separation between Domain Logic, Data Definitions, and 3D Presentation:

* src/Core/ \-\> EventBus, Result\<T,E\>, DependencyContainer, ModuleRegistry, GameClock  
* src/Progression/ \-\> RankFSM, OfficerAttributes, UniformMeshBinder, SkillTreeService  
* src/Gunsmith/ \-\> WeaponChassis, PartSocketGraph, BallisticStatAggregator, DIYWorkbenchController  
* src/Combat/ \-\> DualVectorBallistics, AnatomicalHitbox, StanceController, WeaponSightAligner, BoundingBoxGuard, AcousticReverbSystem  
* src/Narrative/ \-\> DialogueDilemmaEngine, VoiceOverSync, StoryArcManager  
* src/Meta/ \-\> BaseIdleManager, ShipProductionUnit, VehicleCustomizationBay, PresidentialGovernanceSim, BattleMapController  
* src/UI/ \-\> HUDController, PromotionModalWatchdog, PauseSensitivityPanel, CheckpointAdBoundary

## **3\. DETERMINISTIC GAMEPLAY LOGIC & REALISM CONTRACTS**

### **3.1 STRICT COMBAT & AIMING VALIDATION ("AIM-TO-DAMAGE" CONTRACT)**

Damage calculation is strictly forbidden from using proximity checks, auto-damage timers, or unvalidated screen-center triggers. Every projectile discharge MUST satisfy all six logical gates:

> 1. **Mechanical Readiness Gate**:  
   * Weapon can fire IF AND ONLY IF:  
     SafetyState \== SafetyMode.FireAndReload (Position 1\)  
     AND HasChamberedRound \== true  
     AND IsBoltLockedClosed \== true  
     AND IsReloading \== false  
     AND IsMuzzleObstructedByWall \== false  
     AND CurrentTime \>= NextAllowedFireTimestamp (strictly calculated as 60.0 / TruePhysicsRPM; UI display must read this exact variable so HUD RPM and physics RPM never diverge).  
> 2. **FOV-Decoupled Sight Alignment Gate**:  
   * Weapon optical sights and reticles MUST be decoupled from camera Field of View (FOV) scaling to prevent weapon sight misalignment.  
   * In Aim-Down-Sights (ADS) mode, the camera aligns with the OpticSightSocket.forward vector.  
> 3. **Dual-Vector Raycast & Ballistic Intersection Gate**:  
   * When fired, instantiate a physical projectile or stepped ballistic raycast starting strictly at MuzzleTipTransform.position along MuzzleTipTransform.forward modified by mechanical MOA dispersion and current stance sway.  
   * **Aim Validation Rule**: Damage may ONLY be applied if:  
     a) The operator's aiming vector (OpticSightVector in ADS, or MuzzleConeVector in Point-Shooting) intersects the target's physical 3D collider within angular tolerance; AND  
     b) An unobstructed ballistic trajectory exists between MuzzleTipTransform.position and the exact HitImpactPoint on the target without intersecting any EnvironmentCoverLayer geometry first.  
   * If the weapon is not aimed at an enemy collider, or if a wall/shield/obstacle blocks the barrel line-of-sight, **Damage MUST equal 0.0**.  
> 4. **Anatomical Hitbox & Armor Penetration Logic**:  
   * Every character (Player and AI) must have 4 distinct child colliders rather than a single capsule:  
     * Hitbox\_Skull (Cranial): 3.5x damage multiplier; bypasses torso armor; enables realistic Mozambique Drill execution (2 shots to Hitbox\_Torso sternum to stagger \+ 1 precision shot to Hitbox\_Skull).  
     * Hitbox\_Torso (Sternum/Vitals): 1.0x base multiplier; checks TargetArmorLevel against AmmoPenetrationRating.  
     * Hitbox\_Pelvis (Pelvic Girdle): 1.1x damage multiplier; bypasses thoracic plate carriers and immediately zeroes target sprint/walk mobility (ForceProneOrKneelState).  
     * Hitbox\_Limbs (Arms/Legs): 0.45x damage multiplier; arm hits apply AimSwayPenalty, leg hits apply MovementSlowPenalty.  
   * Spawn dynamic Entry Wound and Exit Wound decals based on projectile kinetic energy residue.  
> 5. **Stance Physics & Recoil Enforcement**:  
   * Support 3 handgun/carbine stances and 3 rifle postures:  
     * Isosceles: Maximum frontal armor coverage, standard stability.  
     * Weaver: Angled silhouette (reduced target profile), enhanced vertical recoil recovery.  
     * Harries: Off-hand tactical flashlight braced beneath weapon wrist for night/darkness operations, eliminating darkness accuracy penalties within beam cone.  
     * Postures: Standing, Crouched, Prone.  
   * Every shot MUST apply physical spring-based camera and weapon recoil impulse. Even rapid-fire shotguns or semi-auto rifles must accumulate full per-shot recoil impulse (never allow rapid-click zero-recoil exploits).  
> 6. **Bounding-Box Anti-Clipping & Pose Guards**:  
   * Run a continuous forward capsule check (BoundingBoxGuard). When approaching walls, desks, or barricades, procedurally compress weapon IK posture so barrels and head hitboxes NEVER clip through geometry or ballistic shields.  
   * State Machine Guard: Strictly prohibit simultaneous ProneTransition \+ MeleeAttack or ProneLeaning floor-clipping states.

### **3.2 3D GUNSMITHING & WEAPON CRAFTING ("MAKE AND USE" CONTRACT)**

Weapons are modular assemblies built in the 3D Gunsmith Workbench (DIYWorkbenchController) and persisted as JSON serialization graphs.

> 1. **Core Chassis & 7-Slot Socket Tree**:  
   * Every weapon begins with a ReceiverChassis (StandardAlloy or TitaniumMatch) with a fixed BeddingGeometryRating.  
   * Required Attachment Sockets:  
     * Socket\_Barrel: Defines Caliber (9x19mm, .45ACP, 5.56x45mm, .308Win, .300WinMag, 12Gauge), BarrelLengthCm (57cm standard / 62cm magnum), ProfileMm (16mm), and MuzzleThread (M14). Swapping barrels on a precision chassis preserves \< 3.0 SUB MOA zero alignment because the optic mount locks to the barrel bedding geometry.  
     * Socket\_BoltAction: Supports standard rotating bolts or the BRX1\_LinearBolt (45-degree handle above trigger, straight back-and-forward cycle, zero-jam rapid cycling, reversible 180-degree left/right ejection).  
     * Socket\_TriggerGroup: Adjustable pull weight from 900g to 1500g in 3 stages, reducing TriggerInputDelayMs and TriggerJerkMOA. Includes 3-Position Manual Safety:  
       * Pos1\_FireAndReload: Trigger active, bolt unlocked.  
       * Pos2\_SafeLoadUnload: Trigger blocked, bolt unlocked for safe chamber clearing.  
       * Pos3\_FullLock: Trigger blocked, bolt mechanically locked.  
     * Socket\_OpticMount: Supports Picatinny, QuickDetach, and SignatureRings. Optics must implement either:  
       * SFP\_Reticle (Second Focal Plane): Constant visual reticle thickness; MOA holdover math is exact at max zoom (25x) and doubles at half zoom (12.5x).  
       * FFP\_Reticle (First Focal Plane): Reticle scales dynamically with magnification (5x to 25x); MRAD subtensions remain exact at all zoom levels.  
       * Includes ParallaxAdjustment (10m to Infinity) and ZeroStopTurret (instant mechanical return to 0 elevation).  
     * Socket\_Muzzle: Accepts ThreadProtector, FTE\_MuzzleBrake (reduces muzzle climb, increases lateral acoustic blast), or SoundSuppressor (eliminates muzzle flash, reduces acoustic radius, models realistic FirstShotPop decibel spike on initial round, and caps muzzle smoke particle alpha so smoke VFX never obscures the optic view).  
     * Socket\_StockAndPad: Configurable Length of Pull (365mm base \+ 12.7mm spacers), MicroCorePad (faster ADS mount speed without snagging), and KickOffHydraulicBuffer (KickOff\_I, KickOff\_Plus, KickOff\_Mega) providing up to 70% recoil impulse reduction.  
     * Socket\_Magazine: Discrete magazine entities tracked individually in tactical vest slots. Supports TacticalReload (retains 1 round in chamber \+ swaps partial mag) and DryReload (requires bolt cycling).

### **3.3 RANK HIERARCHY, UNIFORM BINDING, AND SOFT-LOCK PREVENTION**

> 1. **Strict Monotonic Rank Enumeration (RankEnum)**:  
   * 0: E1\_PVT (Recruit / Private)  
   * 1: E4\_CPL (Corporal)  
   * 2: E6\_SSG (Staff Sergeant)  
   * 3: O1\_LT (Lieutenant)  
   * 4: O3\_CPT (Captain)  
   * 5: O5\_LTC (Lieutenant Colonel)  
   * 6: O7\_BG (Brigadier General)  
   * 7: O10\_GEN (Four-Star General / Army Commander)  
   * 8: CIV\_PRES (Commander-in-Chief / President)  
> 2. **Anti-Regression Invariant (Fixes Legacy Chapter 8 Bug)**:  
   * RankProgressionService.PromoteTo(NewRank) MUST enforce: assert(NewRank \> CurrentSavedRank).  
   * Never allow any chapter loader (especially Chapter 8+) to overwrite CurrentSavedRank with a default E1\_PVT fallback. HUD rank badges must bind strictly to ImmutableLedger.GetRank().  
> 3. **Promotion Ceremony Watchdog (Fixes Legacy General Level Freeze)**:  
   * When the promotion dialogue triggers ("Ranking officer to a new rank"), the UI modal MUST start a 3.0s unscaled-time coroutine watchdog. Even if voice audio or character animation events fail to fire, the Continue button MUST automatically become visible and interactable within 3.0s.  
> 4. **Dynamic Uniform & Character Customization Binding**:  
   * Every promotion event publishes OnRankChanged(OldRank, NewRank) on the EventBus.  
   * UniformMeshBinder listens to OnRankChanged and automatically updates the character's 3D skeletal garment mesh, shoulder epaulets, collar insignia, headgear, and garrison/tactical uniform preset while preserving selected facial, hair, and gear customization.

### **3.4 NARRATIVE DILEMMAS, IDLE META-GAME, AND PRESIDENTIAL ENDGAME**

> 1. **Tactical & Political Dilemma Engine**:  
   * Replace obvious binary dialogue prompts with nuanced 3-way leadership decisions during academy boards, field interrogations, TV interviews, and public rallies.  
   * Each choice modifies TacticalDoctrine, UnitMorale, and PoliticalCapital (-100 to \+100).  
> 2. **Base, Vehicle, and Naval Production Meta (ZoomOutMetaCamera)**:  
   * Integrate the smooth pinch/toggle meta-camera zoom-out (MetaCameraController) connecting the 3D Academy grounds, Vehicle Customization Bay, Naval Ship Production Dockyard, and Tactical Battle Map.  
   * Ship and vehicle production queues run on deterministic timestamps (CurrentUTC \- ProductionStartUTC) so offline progress is calculated accurately without frame-dependent drift.  
> 3. **Presidential National Development Endgame (CIV\_PRES)**:  
   * Upon reaching CIV\_PRES, unlock the Strategic Command & National Governance loop: enact legislative and constitutional roles, allocate GDP across Civil Infrastructure, Defense R\&D, and Naval/Ground Fleets, manage international diplomacy, and command high-stakes special operations rather than repeating basic recruit drills.  
> 4. **Session Flow & Non-Intrusive Checkpoint Guard**:  
   * Strictly forbid any interstitial ad hook, store prompt, or battle-pass popup from executing while CombatState \== ActiveMission. Monetization, reward summaries, and save checkpoints may ONLY trigger after OnMissionCompleted or OnMissionFailed state transitions.

## **4\. MODULE LOCK REGISTRY TEMPLATE (MODULE\_REGISTRY.json)**

Maintain this state tracker in the root directory. Whenever a feature passes verification, update its status to "LOCKED\_VERIFIED" so future AI agent sessions extend rather than replace it:  
{  
"Core\_EventBus\_Result": "LOCKED\_VERIFIED",  
"Progression\_RankFSM\_UniformBinder": "PENDING\_IMPLEMENTATION",  
"Gunsmith\_ModularSocketGraph": "PENDING\_IMPLEMENTATION",  
"Combat\_DualVectorBallistics\_Hitboxes": "PENDING\_IMPLEMENTATION",  
"Narrative\_DilemmaEngine": "PENDING\_IMPLEMENTATION",  
"Meta\_ShipVehicle\_PresidentialSim": "PENDING\_IMPLEMENTATION"  
}

## **Operational Synthesis for Vibecoding Execution**

Maximizing engineering velocity while preventing architectural regression requires disciplined adherence to repository initialization, prompt isolation, and diff auditing throughout the development lifecycle16. Before generating any gameplay scripts, the engineering environment should be bootstrapped with GAME\_MASTER\_SPEC.md in the root directory, the core rules header placed in .cursor/rules/00-core-architecture.mdc, and the MODULE\_REGISTRY.json state tracker initialized16. When directing the AI agent to construct Phase 1 (Core\_EventBus\_Result), operating in Plan Mode (Shift+Tab) ensures the agent maps out exact interfaces first; once the unit tests pass and the working tree is committed to version control, flipping "Core\_EventBus\_Result" to "LOCKED\_VERIFIED" establishes a permanent boundary against future overwrites23.  
As development advances into the 3D Gunsmith and Combat phases, prompts must be strictly isolated by subsystem boundary rather than combining multiple features into a single request21. Directing an agent to build the gunsmith workbench, the ballistic shooting range, and Chapter 8 story missions simultaneously invites context drift and hallucinated dependencies17. Instead, scoping each prompt to a single domain contract—such as first generating Gunsmith/BallisticStatAggregator to compute weapon mass, MOA dispersion, and KickOff recoil mitigation from attached weapon parts, verifying its mathematical output via unit tests, and locking the module before wiring the 3D camera controller—preserves deterministic accuracy9. Finally, conducting line-by-line Git diff audits prior to accepting agent output ensures that locked services like RankProgressionService are never inadvertently altered during UI or meta-game tasks, enabling the simulation to scale cleanly from basic recruit training to strategic presidential command8.
